_comment: When this attacks or hits, you MAY destroy an aura you control; if you do, create a Runechant token. The MAY is gated on CONTROLS_SUBTYPE Aura so it is only offered when you have an aura, and the block destroys a chosen aura then creates the Runechant (declining runs neither). Prior JSON destroyed the attack ITSELF (target 'self') and created the Runechant unconditionally.

effects.prompt: Destroy an aura you control to create a Runechant?
